# sigma_tenant (Resource)

A Sigma tenant organization for embedded analytics. Tenants are child organizations provisioned under a parent org. `cloud_provider` is immutable after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provision a tenant organization for embedded analytics.
#
# `cloud_provider` is immutable after creation — changing it forces replacement.
resource "sigma_tenant" "acme" {
  name           = "Acme Corp"
  slug           = "acme-corp"
  cloud_provider = "aws"
}

# Tenant that inherits the parent org's cloud provider (omit cloud_provider).
resource "sigma_tenant" "beta_customer" {
  name = "Beta Customer"
  slug = "beta-customer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the tenant organization.
- `slug` (String) URL identifier for the tenant organization. Must be unique within the parent org.

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider to host the tenant in. One of: `aws`, `aws-au`, `aws-ca`, `aws-eu`, `aws-uk`, `aws-us-a`, `azure-ca`, `azure-eu`, `azure-uk`, `azure-us`, `gcp`, `gcp-us`. Defaults to the parent org's cloud provider.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `parent_org_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_tenant.example '<tenant_organization_id>'
```
